user.title: Connect a Home Panel
user.description: Read-only configuration companion. The panel must provide capabilities.v1 and a stable factory ID. Keep the ESPHome integration for live states and controls. Use HTTP only on a trusted LAN/VPN.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.45, without a path or credentials.
data_description.access_key: Current panel debug/configuration API key; stored only in the HA backend.

reconfigure.title: Change panel connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address and key. The panel must have the same factory ID as before.

reauth_confirm.title: Update panel access key
reauth_confirm.description: The key was rejected. The existing address and paired factory ID will be retained.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read panel metadata. Check the address, network and panel availability.
error.invalid_auth: The panel rejected the access key.
error.invalid_connection: Enter an HTTP(S) origin without credentials, a path or query, and a nonempty access key.
error.unsupported_firmware: Firmware metadata is missing or incompatible. Stable factory identity and capabilities.v1 are required; setup cannot use the IP address as identity.
error.wrong_device: This is not the paired panel, or its factory ID is unavailable. The existing pairing has not been changed.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already configured. Change its address or key using Reconfigure.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection was updated without changing the paired panel.

data_description.poll_interval: 30 to 600 seconds. No household device commands are sent.
